messages:
Sam G: Quick async on the Acme trial timeline — we need a runnable staging POC by next Thursday (2026-04-02). Core deliverables: SSO + SCIM test account, data ingestion webhook, example prompt set for billing reconciliation, and a basic throughput profile (50 requests/s target).
Maya (SE): Got it. Can we lock success criteria? Customer wants: 1) end-to-end demo with SSO, 2) <5s median latency for 512 tokens, 3) determinism on the prompt set (within tolerance). Also need the customer's infra contact for VPC peering.
Luis S: Legal milestone is sign-off on the security questionnaire by Wednesday — that unlocks VPC creds. I'm following up with Acme legal, will update when we have their contact.
Olivia P: Ownership suggestion: Sam/eng-runtime owns latency profile and model variant, Raj/eng-infra owns peering + staging network, Maya SE owns integration tests & demo script, Luis handles contract gating. Agree?
Sam G: Agree. Assigning owners: eng-runtime -> @Sam G (latency + model variant), eng-infra -> @Raj (VPC preview + CIDR), SE -> @Maya (integration tests + demo), Sales -> @Luis (customer gating). Please ack.
Maya (SE): Ack. Dependency note: Acme requires IP allowlist + mutual TLS for webhooks. Raj — do we have a quick way to stand up a preview endpoint with mTLS for them?
Raj (eng-infra): We can provision a preview VPC and an mTLS endpoint by Tue EOD. Need the Acme CIDR range and the cert thumbprint. If legal delays, we can use a temporary proxy but won't satisfy their compliance for the demo.
Maya (SE): Contact is emma.jones@acme.com. CIDR pending legal but likely 10.11.0.0/16. I'll push a WT with them today.
Sam G: Small engineering asks: can eng-runtime shave the median down by changing batching config? Also please drop a PR for the infra terraform in the staging repo and ping for review.
Raj (eng-infra): Will do. ETA: terraform PR by Mon AM. Quick note: the mTLS proxy approach requires a cert; if we use self-signed for staging, mention it in the demo script.
Maya (SE): Example test command for the integration team to run locally:
```
pytest tests/poc_integration.py::test_acme_flow -k smoke -q
```
Ping me once staging URL + creds are up.
Sam G: Also, code review ping: PR #3147 (batching backpressure) and PR #3150 (kv-cache fix) need quick reviews — these impact latency numbers. If reviewers can aim for EOD Tue that helps.
Luis S: Noted. I'll nudge the reviewers in the account thread.
Raj (eng-infra): Potential blocker: the production quantized model we've been testing has a different tokenization edge-case, which could affect determinism. Fallback plan is to use hosted non-quantized variant for the demo if determinism fails.
Sam G: Good fallback. If we go hosted for demo, make sure to document cost delta. Also add a note in the rollout plan for rollback to quantized once we validate tokenization.
Deploy Bot: staging-acme-preview has been created (env: staging-acme-prv). URL: https://staging-acme-prv.redwood.dev — credentials pending.
Maya (SE): :thumbsup: I'll coordinate with Acme on creds and share a demo checklist when we have the staging URL.
Olivia P: Thanks all — I'll capture this in the POC tracker and tag owners.
Sam G: Thanks team — next sync only if anything blocks. Otherwise we'll go async.
